Contact CalcPhi

We are a small, focused team and we read every message we receive. Whether you have spotted a calculation error, have a suggestion, or are interested in working with us — reach out and we will get back to you.

General Support & Feedback

For all general questions, feedback, and calculator-related queries:

Email: support@blackbeltcodelabs.com

We aim to respond within 2 business days (Monday–Friday, IST). For faster answers to common questions, check our Help section first.

Report a Calculation Error

Accuracy is the most important thing we do. If you believe a calculator is producing an incorrect result, please let us know. When reporting an error, it helps to include:

  • The name of the calculator (e.g. SIP Calculator)
  • The exact inputs you used
  • The result CalcPhi showed you
  • The result you expected, with a source or reference if you have one

Send error reports to: support@blackbeltcodelabs.com with the subject line "Calculation Error — [Calculator Name]".

Verified errors are corrected within 48 hours and the correction is noted on the relevant page.

Advertising & Partnerships

CalcPhi reaches high-intent finance audiences at the moment they are actively evaluating financial products. We work with financial brands through display advertising and contextual affiliate partnerships.

If you represent a financial product or service relevant to our audience — mutual fund platforms, loan providers, insurance companies, tax software — we would be happy to discuss how we can work together.

Partnership enquiries: support@blackbeltcodelabs.com with the subject line "Partnership Enquiry".

Content & Editorial

If you are a financial professional, researcher, or SEBI/SEC-registered advisor who would like to contribute to or review CalcPhi content, we welcome that conversation.

Send editorial enquiries to: support@blackbeltcodelabs.com with the subject line "Editorial".

About the Company

CalcPhi is developed and maintained by Black Belt Code Labs. For more information about us, visit our About page.
